# Model card (generated by scripts/train_robust.py)

## Crop model

Selected: **openclip_vitb32 head x zero-shot prior** (highest wild_val crop accuracy; ties -> lower CPU latency).

| Candidate | Clean val crop acc | Wild val crop acc | CPU ms / image (TTA) | Selected |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| dinov2_vits14 + logistic head | 1.000 | 0.976 | 154 |  |
| openclip_vitb32 + logistic head | 1.000 | 0.976 | 117 |  |
| openclip_vitb32 zero-shot | 0.818 | 0.880 | 120 |  |
| openclip_vitb32 head x zero-shot prior | 0.996 | 0.988 | 113 | yes |
| efficientnet_b0 fine-tuned (B03 aug) | 1.000 | 0.964 | 420 |  |

Training data: TRAIN split only (see data/processed/splits.csv), 8 background-swap views per image for frozen-backbone heads. Inference: mean probability over TTA views (full, horizontal flip, 4 corner crops) plus 3x3 plant tiles for field scenes.

## Disease model

mobilenet_v2 (ImageNet-pretrained) with one diseased/healthy logit per crop; trained 16 epochs (3.6 min on mps), best epoch 11 by clean VAL macro-F1 0.964. Evaluated with TTA (no tiles):

| Set | n (labelled) | Accuracy | Macro-F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| clean_val | 242 | 0.975 | 0.969 |
| clean_test | 239 | 0.996 | 0.994 |
| wild_val | 63 | 0.968 | 0.968 |
| wild_test | 62 | 0.935 | 0.935 |

## Augmentation

Background swap (leaf cut out with the Stage 1 mask, composited onto inpainted TRAIN backgrounds of either crop, procedural soil/foliage or plain colours), same-crop collages, RandomResizedCrop, rotation, colour jitter, blur, JPEG re-compression, random erasing (configs/default.yaml `augment`).

## Limits

- Training images come from one black gram and one turmeric dataset; field scenes of turmeric are absent from training and only simulated by compositing.
- Wild labelled images are single leaves on white; field scenes are disease-unlabelled.
- Confidence is calibrated separately (P2-B05); uncertain crop predictions are surfaced, not hidden.
